title: Production acceptance: deploy all current code to existing watcher
purpose: Publish and install the entire operator-authorized current source in the existing production watcher, without adopting historical unfinished task claims.
success_outcome: Exact published commit installed/running healthy, staged and live doctor pass, old data/env and unrelated host state preserved; no automatic keyword monitor enabled.
anti_goals: No new product implementation or old task closure.
No unrelated services/firewall/routes/SELinux changes, no DB replacement/reset/manual migration or real delivery probes.
constraints: Operator explicitly authorized all fresh source on 2026-10-07, including rental fallback.
Reuse existing isolated systemd upgrade; exact commit FF only; staged doctor SQLite clone; preserve every existing table and file identity.
invariants: No secret/token/env content output; backups root-only on host.
Only watcher checkout/build/backup/install/service may change; automatic additive Store schema init accepted, no reset.

forbidden_scope: Production data deletion/replacement/reset/manual migration, env edits, real notification probes
stop_conditions: Ambiguous unhealthy runtime, dirty/diverged checkout or commit mismatch
Failed native build/staged doctor or materially changed host identity

verification_targets: FT-005-AC-010 — read-only installed version baseline RED (old commit); equivalent exact published/target/running commit GREEN. State-loss/isolation RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: inducing loss or host harm is unsafe; alternative proof: backup plus stable stopped/post-start table data, settings/env/DB identity and unrelated host fingerprint comparison. Staged doctor on disposable SQLite clone; cleanup, exact FF rerun and rollback scoped to watcher.
evidence_required: FT-005-AC-010 — ordered redacted receipts .tasks/TASK-013-T3-FT-005-W6/release.log and preflight/postflight JSON: RED: installed old commit differs from accepted release; GREEN: published/target/running exact accepted commit; state-loss/isolation RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: inducing production harm is unsafe; alternative proof: stable stopped/post-start preserved-state and unrelated fingerprints, native local/target gates, checksum/linkage, staged/live doctor, healthy single unit/process NRestarts=0, preserved all old seen/settings/state/offset and env/DB identity; unrelated fingerprints equal; backup path and cleanup.
